title: Sangchu Geotjeori Fresh Lettuce Salad
shortDescription: Tender leaf lettuce is dried well and tossed immediately before serving with soy sauce, fish sauce, vinegar, gochugaru, garlic, onion, sesame oil, and sesame seeds.
culturalContext: Sangchu geotjeori is a fresh, immediately dressed lettuce preparation rather than a long-fermented kimchi. Its quick tangy-spicy seasoning makes it a common companion to rice and grilled food; fish-free and other household variations also exist.
author: {{LEGAL_NAME}}
equipment: Chef’s knife and produce cutting board

instructions.heading: Inspect and wash
instructions.action: Discard slimy or damaged leaves. Wash lettuce, onion, and scallion under cool running water using a clean basin and produce-only work area.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Produce is crisp, clean, and free of grit or decay.
instructions.safetyNote: Keep ready-to-eat produce separate from raw meat, poultry, and seafood.

instructions.heading: Dry and tear
instructions.action: Spin lettuce dry or blot with clean towels, then tear into large bite-size pieces by hand. Slice onion and scallion on a clean board.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Lettuce is dry, crisp, and large enough not to collapse immediately in dressing.
instructions.safetyNote: Use a cleaned spinner and fresh towels to prevent recontamination.

instructions.heading: Chill briefly
instructions.action: Refrigerate the prepared lettuce in a clean covered container for 10 minutes while making the dressing.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Leaves feel cold and crisp with no pooled water.
instructions.safetyNote: Do not leave cut lettuce at room temperature while other meal components are prepared.

instructions.heading: Mix the dressing
instructions.action: In a clean large bowl, combine garlic, onion, scallion, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar, vinegar, gochugaru, and sesame oil until sugar dissolves.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Dressing is evenly red and no sugar granules remain on the bowl.
instructions.safetyNote: Declare soy, wheat/gluten, fish, and sesame allergens.

instructions.heading: Toss gently
instructions.action: Add cold lettuce and fold gently with clean hands or tongs just until coated. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Leaves are glossy but still voluminous and distinct.
instructions.safetyNote: Use clean hands or utensils and do not return tasted utensils to the bowl.

instructions.heading: Serve immediately
instructions.action: Transfer to a clean bowl and serve at once; do not hold for fermentation.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Lettuce remains crisp with minimal liquid at the bottom.
instructions.safetyNote: Keep separate from raw grill utensils and discard after more than 2 hours at room temperature.

grillSetup: No grill is used for the salad; place it on the cooked-food side of a tabletop setup and protect it from raw-meat tongs and splatter.
visualDonenessCues: Washed lettuce is dry and crisp
Sugar is dissolved in the dressing
Salad remains voluminous and is served immediately
foodSafetyNotes: Discard slimy or decayed leaves and wash produce under cool potable running water.
Use clean hands, spinner, towels, board, bowls, and utensils.
Keep prepared lettuce refrigerated until the last-minute toss.
Keep the salad separate from raw meat and raw-food utensils.
Serve immediately; this geotjeori is not a room-temperature fermentation project.

allergens.crossContactWarning: Contains soy, wheat/gluten, fish, and sesame; verify sauce labels and prevent cross-contact at tabletop grills.

substitutions: Use certified gluten-free tamari only after checking the full label.
For a fish-free adaptation, replace fish sauce only after testing salt and umami balance.
ingredientSourcing: Choose unwilted red or green leaf lettuce with crisp ribs and no slimy edges.
Use coarse Korean gochugaru rather than cayenne for the intended chile texture.
makeAhead: Wash, dry, and chill lettuce up to 4 hours ahead; mix dressing separately and combine only at serving.
storage: Dressed salad is best immediately. Refrigerate any uncontaminated leftovers promptly and use within 1 day; discard table-exposed portions with uncertain handling.
leftovers: Use continuously refrigerated leftovers in a rice bowl within 1 day, accepting substantial wilting; do not save raw-tool-contaminated salad.
servingSuggestions: Serve immediately with bulgogi or galbi
Add to rice with a cooked protein for a quick bowl

faq.question: Is sangchu geotjeori fermented?
faq.answer: No. This lettuce preparation is dressed and eaten right away rather than held for fermentation.

faq.question: Why must the lettuce be dry?
faq.answer: Surface water dilutes the dressing and makes the delicate leaves collapse faster.
